definition.heading: What is workforce capability development?
definition.lede: The short answer, and how it differs from training.
definition.answer: Workforce capability development is the work of building what your people can do, and proving it changed. Some call it capability building. It starts with the capability your strategy needs. It measures where each role stands, closes the priority gaps with the right mix of training, coaching and organizational change, and then measures again.
definition.more: Capability development services bring that whole cycle under one partner. Training is one part of it. Capability development is the system around it.

items.question: What are capability development services?
items.answer: Capability development services help an organization build the skills, behaviors and leadership its strategy depends on, and prove the change. Edstellar's services cover the full cycle: assessment, gap analysis, solution design, delivery through training and coaching, and measurement again.

items.question: What is enterprise capability development?
items.answer: Enterprise capability development applies that cycle across a whole organization, with every function, role and region on one shared capability model. It links people data to business goals, so leaders can see where capability is strong, where it is missing and what is being done about it.

items.question: How is capability development different from training?
items.answer: Training is one tool inside capability development. Capability development starts from the capability the business needs, measures it before and after, and combines training with coaching, assessments, organizational change and on-the-job support. For training programs on their own, see Edstellar corporate training.

items.question: How do you measure workforce capability?
items.answer: Edstellar measures capability by role, using validated assessments, 360-degree feedback, manager ratings and work evidence, brought together in Capability OS. Each skill is rated on clear proficiency levels, so progress shows up as movement between levels, not course completions.

items.question: How long does a capability development program take?
items.answer: A first 5A cycle usually takes three to five months: about 6 to 10 weeks to assess, analyze and design, then 6 to 12 weeks of delivery. Measurement then continues, and each new cycle builds on the last.

items.question: Can we start with just one service?
items.answer: Yes. Many clients start with an assessment, a training needs analysis or a coaching program, then add more as the capability picture grows. Every service uses the same capability model, so nothing has to be redone.

items.question: Where does Edstellar deliver capability programs?
items.answer: Edstellar delivers in 100+ countries and 10+ languages, onsite, virtually or blended, across the Americas, EMEA and APAC.
